What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Vader's Custom TIE (V)]]: left, the image of [[Vader's Custom TIE (V)]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[Vader's Custom TIE (V) (Errata)]] (holotable commit a5142dd). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/vaderscustomtie.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/vaderscustomtie.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
